facts.business: RRIL Limited is engaged in the activities of Textile Products and Real Estate Development, developing residential, commercial, retail and social infrastructure projects, with a wholly owned subsidiary Raj Rajendra Industries Limited manufacturing textile products.

auditor.name: M/s Subramanian Bengali & Associates Chartered Accountants, Mumbai

key_risks: Fluctuations in the prices of cotton, man-made fibres, dyes, and chemicals can increase production costs and adversely affect profit margins.
Shortages of skilled labour, increasing wage levels, and changing labour regulations may affect productivity and operating costs.
Higher electricity, fuel, and gas prices increase manufacturing costs, particularly in energy-intensive textile processes such as spinning, weaving, and dyeing.
Ongoing geopolitical conflicts, trade disputes, sanctions, and disruptions in international shipping routes can affect supply chains, increase logistics costs, and delay deliveries.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include remuneration to KMPs (Ratanchand D Jain: Rs 60.00 Lakhs, Rishit D Shah: Rs 12.00 Lakhs, Sunil Giri: Rs 11.90 Lakhs), advances and interest with Rishabraj Estate Developers Pvt Ltd (Closing balance Rs 1348.93 Lakhs), Rishabraj Infra LLP (Closing balance Rs 1143.76 Lakhs), and Sumati Spintex Private Limited (Closing balance Rs 436.55 Lakhs).
